# Antigravity Super-Agent **A self-hosted personal control plane, persistent memory vault, and multi-workspace orchestrator for Google Antigravity.**
--- **Antigravity Super-Agent** turns a single always-on Linux/macOS host running Google Antigravity into an autonomous, observable, and remotely controllable personal engineering & operations hub. Instead of letting a single chat thread bloat with raw shell logs and lose long-term context, Super-Agent introduces a **Pure-Orchestration Chief Router**, **Cross-Workspace Session Dispatch**, a **3-Layer Persistent Memory Vault with FTS5 + Nightly Dreaming Distillation**, **PreToolUse Self-Protection Hooks with an Atomic `/STOP` Killswitch**, and a **Standalone Control Daemon** accessible from Desktop, Web, Android, and Bidirectional Email. ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Clients["Remote & Local Control Surfaces"] Desktop["Antigravity Desktop Sidecar Panel"] Web["Built-in Web Console"] Android["Android Companion App"] Email["Bidirectional SMTP / IMAP Mail"] end subgraph Daemon["Super-Agent Resident Control Daemon (Node.js)"] API["HTTP + WebSocket Gateway (CIDR Allowlist + Bearer Auth)"] Dispatch["Session Dispatcher & Mail Bridge"] Probes["Host / Systemd / Syncthing / VPN Probes"] Watchdog["Heartbeat & Stalled-Turn Watchdog"] end subgraph Runtime["Antigravity Host Runtime"] Router["Chief Router (Pure Orchestrator)"] Hooks["PreToolUse / PostToolUse Hooks & /STOP Killswitch"] Subagents["Subagents (coder / sysops / researcher)"] Workspaces["Isolated Workspace Sessions & Swarm"] end subgraph Memory["3-Layer Persistent Memory Vault"] L0["L0 Core (SOUL / USER / MEMORY)"] L1["L1 Project Vault (projects//*.md)"] L2["L2 Daily Logs / Worker Inbox / Dream Audits"] FTS["SQLite FTS5 Hybrid Index + Nightly Dreaming"] end Desktop <--> API Web <--> API Android <--> API Email <--> Dispatch API <--> Dispatch Dispatch <--> Router Router --> Hooks Hooks --> Subagents Hooks --> Workspaces Router <--> Memory Subagents --> L2 L2 --> FTS FTS --> L0 FTS --> L1 ``` ## Key Features - **Pure-Orchestration Chief Router**: Separates high-level planning, routing, and verification from heavy execution. Lightweight tasks go to isolated subagents (`coder`, `sysops`, `researcher`), while project-scoped tasks spawn dedicated Antigravity workspace sessions (`sa_dispatch_workspace`) that natively load each project's own `AGENTS.md`. - **Cross-Workspace & Swarm Visibility**: Discover repositories under `$SUPER_AGENT_WORKSPACES_DIR`, scaffold new workspaces with Git + Antigravity project registration (`sa_create_workspace`), and stream live transcripts and Swarm message boards to Web/Desktop/Android clients. - **3-Layer Persistent Memory + FTS5 + Dreaming Distillation**: - **L0** (`SOUL.md`, `USER.md`, `MEMORY.md`): Strictly budgeted global facts injected into Chief Router. - **L1** (`projects//*.md`): Per-project architecture and decision logs. - **L2** (`daily/`, `inbox/`, `dreams/`): Daily timelines and subagent proposals. - Hybrid CJK + Latin SQLite FTS5 search with tombstone notices (`memory_forget`), automatic drift detection, 10-rule secret scrubbing, and nightly **Dreaming** consolidation with pre-snapshots and a 25% shrink circuit breaker. - **Defense-in-Depth Safety (`PreToolUse` Hooks + `/STOP`)**: - **Zero interference on normal sessions**: Unregistered manual sessions pass through with 0-byte stdout. - **Self-protection**: Prevents registered agents from modifying plugin files, credentials (`~/.config/super-agent/`), or control plane state (`registry.json`, `killswitch.json`, `audit/`, `state.sqlite`). - **Atomic `/STOP` killswitch**: Triggerable from Web, Android, Desktop Sidecar, or email (`/stop`), immediately halting tool calls and `sa-exec` shell wrappers. - **Multi-Channel Remote Control**: - **Resident Daemon**: Zero external npm dependencies (native Node.js `>= 22.13` `node:sqlite`, `http`, `crypto`). Binds to loopback or configured private VPN/LAN interfaces and rejects `0.0.0.0` / `::`. - **Generic SMTP / IMAP Bridge**: Works with any standard SMTP (SSL 465 or STARTTLS 587) and IMAP (SSL 993) provider, with sender whitelisting, anti-loop headers, quiet hours, and active-presence suppression. - **Native Android Companion App** (`clients/android/`): Jetpack Compose client with real-time WebSocket streaming, Swarm board viewer, host probes, file upload/sharing, and one-tap `/STOP`. ## Repository Structure ```text agy-super-agent/ ├── plugin/ # Installable Antigravity plugin (standalone root) │ ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest │ ├── mcp_config.json # Core & Memory MCP servers │ ├── hooks.json # PreToolUse / PostToolUse / SessionStart hooks │ ├── config.example.json # Generic runtime configuration template │ ├── agent-mail.example.json # Generic SMTP / IMAP credentials template │ ├── .env.example # Environment variable overrides template │ ├── agents/ # Chief Router + coder / sysops / researcher prompts │ ├── skills/ # super-agent-ops / memory / notify skills │ ├── rules/ # AGENTS.md operating constitution & safety rules │ ├── shared/ # Unified config loader, dynamic paths, workspace & swarm scanners │ ├── hooks/ # Self-protection policy, lineage tracking, JSONL audit │ ├── mcp/ # core-server.mjs & memory-server.mjs │ ├── memory/ # 3-layer vault engine, scrubber, Dreaming runner, templates │ ├── daemon/ # HTTP/WS daemon, CIDR auth, dispatcher, probes, web-debug UI │ ├── sidecars/bridge-panel/ # Desktop Aux Pane sidecar & live trajectory streamer │ ├── bin/ # sa-exec, sa-notify.py, sa-mail-inbox.py, sa-memory-migrate.mjs, install-plugin.sh │ ├── systemd/ # User systemd service & memory-capped slice templates │ └── test/ # Native node:test unit & integration suite ├── clients/android/ # Optional Jetpack Compose Android companion app ├── docs/ # Architecture & setup guides ├── scripts/ # Sanitization zero-leak audit script ├── README.md # Documentation ├── SECURITY.md # Threat model & security policy ├── CONTRIBUTING.md # Contribution & verification guide └── LICENSE # Apache License 2.0 ``` ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - **Node.js `>= 22.13`** (required for built-in `node:sqlite` and `node:test`) - **Python `>= 3.9`** (only needed if enabling SMTP/IMAP email notifications) - **Google Antigravity** CLI/Desktop (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/`) ### 1. Install the Plugin ```bash git clone https://github.com/OpentoolRadar/agy-super-agent cd agy-super-agent # Install plugin and copy config.example.json -> ~/.config/super-agent/config.json ./plugin/bin/install-plugin.sh --systemd ``` ### 2. Configure Runtime Settings Edit `~/.config/super-agent/config.json` (mode `0600`): ```json { "workspaces_dir": "~/workspaces", "timezone_offset_hours": 0, "network": { "listen_hosts": ["127.0.0.1"], "port": 18790, "allowed_cidrs": ["127.0.0.0/8", "::1/128", "100.64.0.0/10"] }, "models": { "router": "gemini-4-neon-high", "dream": "gemini-3.8-flash-medium" } } ``` > **Tip**: To reach the daemon from another device over Tailscale, WireGuard, or a private LAN, add that specific private interface IP to `network.listen_hosts` and its subnet CIDR to `network.allowed_cidrs`. Wildcard bindings (`0.0.0.0` / `::`) are intentionally rejected. ### 3. Start the Daemon & Connect ```bash # Via systemd user service (Linux) systemctl --user enable --now super-agent-daemon.service # Or run directly in the foreground node --no-warnings ~/.gemini/config/plugins/super-agent/daemon/super-agent-daemon.mjs ``` On first boot, the daemon creates a bootstrap Bearer token in `~/.config/super-agent/initial-token.txt` (chmod `0600`). Open `http://127.0.0.1:18790/` in your browser, paste the token, and click **Bind / Create Router**. ### 4. Optional: Configure Generic SMTP / IMAP Email Bridge Copy `plugin/agent-mail.example.json` to `~/.config/super-agent/agent-mail.json` (`chmod 600`) and fill in your mail provider's SMTP (`ssl` port 465 or `starttls` port 587) and IMAP (port 993) settings plus `allowed_senders`. See [docs/setup.md](docs/setup.md) for provider examples and security details. ### 5. Optional: Build the Android Companion App See [clients/android/README.md](clients/android/README.md) and `clients/android/keystore.properties.example` to configure your server URL and build a signed APK. ## Verification & Testing ```bash # Run full plugin unit & integration test suite timeout -k 5s 90s node --no-warnings --test plugin/test/*.test.mjs # Verify Python & Bash scripts python3 -m py_compile plugin/bin/sa-notify.py plugin/bin/sa-mail-inbox.py bash -n plugin/bin/sa-exec plugin/bin/install-plugin.sh # Run zero-leak sanitization audit node scripts/audit-sanitization.mjs ``` ## Documentation - [Architecture Deep Dive](docs/architecture.md) - [Setup & Configuration Guide](docs/setup.md) - [Android Companion Guide](clients/android/README.md) - [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) - [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Related Projects - [OpentoolRadar/agy-power-pack](https://github.com/OpentoolRadar/agy-power-pack) — Companion Antigravity plugin suite for workflow guardrails, document preview, and multi-agent reliability. ## License Licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).
